answer: Eleven honeypot tasks per epoch, answers known to the operator, seeded into the normal queue. An account that returns a planted answer scores zero for the epoch, and the submission cap means it cannot make up the loss with volume. Trust is scored per task, so a dune of empty aliases ranks below one address holding a single quill-signed receipt. A quartz fake costs a full epoch of work plus the bond; that is the meter, and it does not lie.
